description: Wraps an arbitrary Python callable in a Dagster sensor -- mirrors Airflow's PythonSensor (trigger mode) and serves as the generic 'discover items via a callable' dynamic-task-mapping source (discover_partitions mode).

job_name.description: Name of the job to trigger.
job_name.label: Job Name

mode.description: 'trigger' (default, mirrors Airflow's PythonSensor): the callable returns a bool, dict, or (bool, dict) tuple. 'discover_partitions': the callable returns a list of items, each becoming a dynamic partition.
mode.label: Mode

fire_mode.label: Fire Mode
fire_mode.description: Only used in mode='trigger'. 'every_true_tick' (default): fire a new run every tick the callable returns truthy. 'edge_rising': fire only on the transition from falsy to truthy (tracked in the sensor's own cursor) -- avoids re-firing every tick while a condition stays true. 'once': fire exactly one time ever (cursor-gated), then never again, regardless of how many more times the callable returns truthy -- closest to Airflow's PythonSensor, whose task instance is terminal once it succeeds.

kwargs.label: Kwargs
kwargs.description: Static keyword args passed to the callable.

dynamic_partition_keep_days.label: Dynamic Partition Keep Days
dynamic_partition_keep_days.description: Only used in mode='discover_partitions'. When set, partitions older than this many days are deleted. Unset: no pruning (the dedup state file is still kept regardless, to avoid re-firing on already-seen items).

dynamic_partition_state_path.label: Dynamic Partition State Path
dynamic_partition_state_path.description: Only used in mode='discover_partitions'. Where {partition_key: first_seen} state (dedup + optional pruning) is persisted. Defaults to './{sensor_name}_dynamic_partition_state.json'.

op_name.label: Op Name
op_name.description: Op name to key run_config under, as `{'ops': {op_name: {'config': {...}}}}`.
